data.standardized_narrative: Sirius Syndicate 1945's 2018 financial statements show opening gross claims outstanding at approximately GBP 99.9m (opening balance as at 1 January 2018). The report discusses a number of 2017 large loss catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, Florida windstorm, Mexico earthquakes and California wildfires) as drivers of prior-year portfolio outcomes. A definitive gross prioryear reserves movement (aggregate GROSS prior year strengthening or release) is not explicitly presented or is not unambiguously extractable from the available movement notes/triangles in the scanned pages; therefore no single quantified gross prioryear development amount could be provided from the primary technical reserves reconciliation. Gross written premium for 2018 is ~GBP 100.064m. Due to limits of the scanned pages and mixed presentation (and lack of a clearly labelled gross prioryear movement line), the prior year movement is left unquantified here.
data.data_quality_notes: Document pages provided are scanned images; text extraction is incomplete. The balance sheet row for gross 'Claims outstanding' was identified visually but the scanned quality and rotation makes exact table labels and some numeric provenance uncertain. The primary requested figure (gross prior-year development amount) could not be located with confidence in the scanned pages: no clearly labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column was unambiguously readable. A claims development triangle and a movement note appear in the report but were not reliably extractable from the provided images; as a result prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Opening reserves were taken from the 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative column in the Statement of Financial Position (interpreted as GBP 99,874k  99.874m) with moderate confidence. Gross written premium taken from the Income Statement (100,064k  100.064m) with high confidence. Named events and their pages were identified visually but amounts to the syndicate (net or gross impacts) were not clearly quantified in the accessible scans.
